additional_info.subject: Issue Description EN
additional_info.body:
The screen is poorly calibrated. I restarted the terminal, and disconnected /
reconnected the screen connectors. The problem persists (while
I already had this problem on another terminal, touching the
connectors was enough to solve the problem).
I know that this problem can also be solved with reboots and
time. But in the meantime, the terminal is difficult to use by
customers.
